lines.en: I cannot walk. I can only hang.
A thread of silk holds me under a leaf.
Wind crosses the leaf; I swing along.
The shade of this forest suits me.
I stay perfectly still.
Inside the shell, something is changing.
My colour matches the leaf.
I cling close to the vein.
Raindrops strike my back.
I cannot choose a place. I can only wait.
I hang here in the wetland.
The tree's shadow moves on, and I remain.
I harden little by little.
A ring of fine lines circles my shell.
I am well above the ground.
That thread is what keeps me.
I hang, unmoving.
Inside it moves; outside all is still.
This is not sleep.
I am becoming something else.
There is still dew on the leaf.
Light shines through to the wings inside.
Footsteps sound below the tree.
I cannot move a step.
Time moves slowly through me.
I pull the silk a little tighter.
The sun is too strong, and I shrink in.
Insects are singing here.
You cannot see me.
I am the same colour as the leaf.
Are you picking this leaf?
Do not touch me.
The silk holds me fast.
Look up and search again.
I hang beneath this leaf.
I can only rest once you leave.
Is that a net in your hand.
I cannot even turn my shell.
I swing on my thread.
A small crack in my shell.
The thread I hang from is shaking.
I cannot make a sound at all.
Something stirred inside.

lines.zh: 我努力不让自己掉下去。
lines.en: I fight to keep from dropping.
That jolt aches inside the shell.
One more hit and the silk snaps.
I bear this one from inside the shell.
Still hanging. That will do.
I do not eat at this stage.
The leaf is not for me.
I am inside a shell. I taste nothing.
Leaving it there will not help.
I am only waiting to emerge.
One move of your hand and I sway.

lines.zh: 落在叶上的东西，我不理。
lines.en: Whatever lands on the leaf, I ignore.
Setting it on the leaf will not help.
I have never seen such a thing.
I am busy becoming something else.
That one swung me half a foot out.
The leaf shakes hard.
The silk's anchor is worn white.
I hear every knock on the trunk.
I slid a little along the leaf.
That was dangerous.
I swing slowly back to vertical.
The stalk is struck; I swing aside.
I swing slowly back.
Move away a little.
I have no sex yet.
Only after emerging can that be spoken of.
I am waiting to become an adult.
Not at this stage.
My shell is still sealed.
Wait until the wings come out.
There are others on this tree.
At this stage I have no sex.
A few more days.
The time will come.
That thing is too far from my silk.
I have only this thread.
That is far from me.
The thread is my only tool.
Wait until I grow legs.
I cannot even touch it.
It fell below the tree.
I have neither claws nor hands.
Do not put it here.
Leave it for someone else.
A shadow crosses the wetland.
All I can do is sway.
There is nothing I can do.
I tighten my shell.
That shadow is large.
I hope it leaves soon.
I will pretend to be a leaf.
I hold myself still.
That is my only defence.
I held on.
I keep feeling that movement.
That creature has not gone yet.
I have pulled the silk straight.
My shell is flat to the leaf.
I am not even breathing.
It circled the tree once.
It has not left.
I stay still against the vein.
It has not gone; I hold my breath.
It has gone far.
I have no way to attack.
I have not even grown claws.
My shell is all I have.
Hitting me only hurts yourself.
I am utterly helpless.
I sway once, as a reply.
This is not resistance.
Can you not see.
Here, all I can do is sway.
Careful, do not shake the leaf.
A hairstreak chrysalis hangs under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我把自己裹进了这层壳。
lines.en: I wrapped myself into this shell.
The silk is still damp.
I chose this forest.
The leaf hides me completely.
I take shape in the tree's shade.
A little light passes through the shell.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己会变成什么。
lines.en: I do not know what I will become.
I settle on the thread.
This is safe enough.
So hot. My shell is burning.
The silk let go and I drop.
Water seeps in, and I am stifled.

lines.zh: 叶子被掀翻了，我也被震到。
lines.en: The leaf flipped, and I was jolted.
Something stabbed into my shell.

lines.zh: 这光透进壳里，很不舒服。
lines.en: This light seeps inside, and it is wrong.
I do not eat, yet I grow lighter.
Thunder cracked above the tree.
There is no leaf to hang from.
